assets.title: Open-Throat Carpenter Hand Plane
assets.description: One original static hand-plane prop with a finite flat steel sole and a real through-mouth, paired seafoam cast cheeks, a separate 45-degree iron supported by an inclined frog, a brass lever cap and seated pressure screw, turned walnut toe knob and a closed wooden rear tote with a true hand opening. Ten independently named closed editable meshes have measured interior-witness connections to the sole. Nine unobstructed full-assembly rays pass through the working mouth; three pass through the tote opening. The blunt display edge remains at least 2 mm above the ground plane in the supplied static pose. Metres, Z up, ground-centre origin, toe -X, presentation front -Y. Four solid PBR materials without textures, markings, branding or external assets. One visual tool only; no cutting, sharpening, adjustment, disassembly, ergonomics, accuracy, manufacture or tool-safety guarantee.
